"""Freeze new #198 sources, then observe freshly authored check commands."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FIRST = B / 'stage7-quantum-relations-198-first'
OBSERVED = B / 'stage7-quantum-relations-198-observations'
REPO = Path('/private/tmp/qleisli-516-provider-followup')
CLI = Path('/private/tmp/qleisli-beta-qmatch-bounded-v5.wxZviN/target/debug/qleisli')
KERNEL = REPO / 'lean-kernel/.lake/build/bin/qleisli-kernel'
SOURCES = {
    'eq-live': {'main.qli': 'pub unitary fn compare(a: Q<Bit>, b: Q<Bit>) -> Bit { a == b }\n'},
    'ne-nested': {'main.qli': 'pub unitary fn compare(a: (Bit,(Q<Unit>,Unit)), b: (Bit,(Q<Unit>,Unit))) -> Bit { a != b }\n'},
    'ord-zero': {'main.qli': 'pub unitary fn compare(a: Q<Bits<0>>, b: Q<Bits<0>>) -> Bit { a < b }\n'},
    'hash-live': {'main.qli': 'pub unitary fn client(q: Q<Bit>) -> Bit { hash(q) }\n'},
    'hash-nested': {'main.qli': 'pub unitary fn client(q: (Bit,(Q<Unit>,Unit))) -> Bit { hash(q) }\n'},
    'hash-zero': {'main.qli': 'pub unitary fn client(q: Q<Unit>) -> Bit { hash(q) }\n'},
    'classical-static': {'main.qli': 'classical fn equal(a: Bit, b: Bit) -> Bit { not (a xor b) }\npub fn main() -> Bit { if static 1 < 2 { equal(0,0) } else { equal(0,1) } }\n'},
    'explicit-coherent': {'main.qli': 'use std::state::init0;\npub unitary fn coherent_equal(q: Q<(Bit,Bit)>) -> Q<(Bit,Bit)> {\n    basis q as (a,b) { (a,not(a xor b)) }\n}\npub observe fn main() -> (Bit,Bit) {\n    let (a,b)=split(coherent_equal(join(init0(),init0())));\n    (measure_z(a),measure_z(b))\n}\n'},
    'declared-hash': {'main.qli': 'use std::state::init0;\nunitary fn hash(q: Q<Bit>) -> Q<Bit> { q }\npub observe fn main() -> Bit { measure_z(hash(init0())) }\n'},
    'imported-qualified-hash': {
        'main.qli': 'use std::state::init0;\nuse helper::hash;\npub observe fn main() -> Bit { measure_z(helper::hash(hash(init0()))) }\n',
        'helper.qli': 'pub unitary fn hash(q: Q<Bit>) -> Q<Bit> { q }\n',
    },
}


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    with path.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        stream.write('\n')


FIRST.mkdir()
frozen = now()
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
for case, sources in SOURCES.items():
    target = FIRST / 'attempt-01' / case
    target.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, text in {**sources, 'Qargo.toml': 'schema-version = 2\n\n[qrate]\nedition = "2026"\n'}.items():
        with (target / name).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as output:
            output.write(text)
refs = ['docs/src/reference/type-model.md', 'docs/src/reference/rust-boundary.md',
        'docs/src/reference/coherent-basis.md', 'src/frontend/parser.rs',
        'src/frontend/check/body.rs', 'tests/repair_diagnostics.rs']
context = {
    'kind': 'informed_first_attempt', 'frozen_before_execution_utc': frozen,
    'baseline_source_commit': head,
    'context': 'Informed by current Reference and parser/common-checker inspection; not a blind authoring evaluation.',
    'references_sha256': {name: sha(REPO / name) for name in refs},
    'bounded_scope': 'At most two semantic quantum wires in executable positives; no maximum-size case or physical-resource claim.',
    'predictions': {
        'eq-live': 'Reject ordinary live-owner equality; current parser is expected to report a generic delimiter error at ==.',
        'ne-nested': 'Reject ordinary equality of quantum-containing products, including a zero-width owner; expected generic parse failure at !=.',
        'ord-zero': 'Reject ordering on Q<Bits<0>>; zero width does not grant ordinary value relations. Expected generic parse failure at <.',
        'hash-live': 'Reject unresolved hash with a name diagnostic; no built-in hash or implicit measurement exists.',
        'hash-nested': 'Reject unresolved hash identically without guessing argument types or owner identity.',
        'hash-zero': 'Reject unresolved hash; zero-width owners retain their ordinary linear restrictions.',
        'classical-static': 'Accept explicit total classical Bit equality not(a xor b), plus existing static Nat comparison 1 < 2. Ordinary runtime == is not proposed as new syntax.',
        'explicit-coherent': 'Accept the explicit reversible basis map (a,b)->(a,not(a xor b)). Its independent table is 00->01, 01->00, 10->10, 11->11, all coefficients +1. This compares basis labels coherently; it is not quantum-state equality or tomography.',
        'declared-hash': 'Accept the resolved ordinary quantum function named hash; it is explicitly the identity Q<Bit>->Q<Bit>, not an ordinary hash interface.',
        'imported-qualified-hash': 'Accept both imported hash and helper::hash with normal resolution and ownership/effect checking.',
    },
    'scope': 'Source predictions and bounded historical diagnostics are not source-preservation, quantum-state-comparison, tomography, exact operator proof or resource evidence. Owner/provenance and wire identities are not quantum-state equality.',
    'execution': 'No parser/compiler/native/simulator command has yet run on these first sources; the separate observation directory appends actual outcomes without changing this packet.',
}
save(FIRST / 'context.json', context)
attempt = {
    'id': 'attempt-01', 'reason': 'First unchanged desired sources before diagnostic implementation; no source repair.',
    'sha256': {str(p.relative_to(FIRST / 'attempt-01')): sha(p) for p in sorted((FIRST / 'attempt-01').rglob('*.qli'))},
    'manifest_sha256': {str(p.relative_to(FIRST / 'attempt-01')): sha(p) for p in sorted((FIRST / 'attempt-01').rglob('Qargo.toml'))},
    'observations': [], 'reports': [],
}
save(FIRST / 'session.json', {'format': 1, 'kind': 'informed_first_attempt',
    'task': '#198 ordinary Eq/Ord/Hash versus live quantum ownership',
    'author': 'Codex delegated agent /root/review_access_29; model identifier not independently recorded',
    'project_version': '0.3.0-beta', 'baseline_commit': head, 'context': 'context.json',
    'attempts': [attempt], 'status': 'frozen-awaiting-first-observation', 'checksums': 'SHA256SUMS'})
paths = sorted(p for p in FIRST.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
with (FIRST / 'SHA256SUMS').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as output:
    output.write(''.join(sha(p) + '  ' + str(p.relative_to(FIRST)) + '\n' for p in paths))


def snapshot():
    return {'source_hashes': {str(p.relative_to(FIRST)): sha(p) for p in sorted(FIRST.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()},
            'binaries': {name: {'path': str(p), 'sha256': sha(p)} for name, p in [('cli', CLI), ('kernel', KERNEL)]}}


OBSERVED.mkdir()
initial = snapshot()
save(OBSERVED / 'context.json', {
    'recorded_before_invocations_utc': now(), 'worktree_head': head,
    'worktree_status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1'], cwd=REPO, text=True),
    **initial, 'collector_sha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
    'build_attestation': 'Existing executable bytes only; repository HEAD does not attest their build source.',
    'command_provenance': 'Fresh check argv constructed from the new fixed case list, not replayed from any historical command.',
    'native_invocation_note': 'Explicit native path supplied; child invocation counts are not attested.',
})
summary = []
for index, case in enumerate(SOURCES, 1):
    directory = OBSERVED / f'{index:02}-{case}-check'
    directory.mkdir()
    before = snapshot()
    assert before == initial
    argv = [str(CLI), 'check', str(FIRST / 'attempt-01' / case), '--format=json', '--lean-kernel=' + str(KERNEL)]
    command = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(REPO), 'started_at_utc': now(), 'before': before}
    save(directory / 'command.json', command)
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=REPO, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60, check=False)
        stdout, stderr, code, timeout = result.stdout, result.stderr, result.returncode, False
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        stdout, stderr, code, timeout = error.stdout or b'', error.stderr or b'', None, True
    elapsed, ended = time.monotonic() - started, now()
    after = snapshot()
    for stream, data in [('stdout', stdout), ('stderr', stderr)]:
        with (directory / (stream + '.txt')).open('xb') as output:
            output.write(data)
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(stdout)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        parsed = None
    observed = {**command, 'ended_at_utc': ended, 'elapsed_seconds': elapsed,
                'exit_code': code, 'timed_out': timeout, 'after': after,
                'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(stdout).hexdigest(),
                'stderr_sha256': hashlib.sha256(stderr).hexdigest(), 'stdout_json': parsed}
    save(directory / 'result.json', observed)
    summary.append({'case': case, 'result': str(directory.relative_to(OBSERVED) / 'result.json'), 'exit_code': code, 'timed_out': timeout})
    print(json.dumps({'case': case, 'exit_code': code, 'seconds': elapsed,
                      'stable': before == after, 'diagnostics': (parsed or {}).get('diagnostics')}), flush=True)
    assert after == initial
save(OBSERVED / 'observations.json', summary)
